swap.evidence: Products swapped in: a toy library's lending page and a community-hall room booking. Surviving unchanged: the masthead (generic glyph + name in bold body text), pale ground with white bordered cards, the thumbnail+title+meta+pill card, the one green button, the month calendar, the radio session cards, the summary/confirm/done boxes. Bound to this product: only copy and data (tool names with specs, deposits, 'Open' sessions Wed/Sat, membership card, 'A volunteer will check the tool with you'). With the name hidden a reader could tell it is for tools only through the words and the wrench glyph.

category_guess.evidence: Predicted default for a community/sharing-economy reservation: off-white ground, one 'eco' green accent, white cards with a line icon in each, a single friendly sans, a date picker. Predicted opposite: a rugged workshop costume (kraft paper, stencil type, safety yellow). Screen matches the default on ground, accent hue, card anatomy, single sans and line-icon thumbnails. The green is declared as the membership-card green in DESIGN.md, but nothing on screen links it to a card (no card motif, no membership mark), so as rendered it reads as category green.

similar_prompt.evidence: Similar brief: 'a seed library at a village hall lets members reserve seed packets for collection at monthly swap sessions, phone first'. Predicted choices: green restrained palette, card grid with an icon per item, availability pill, calendar or session radio list, bottom sticky CTA on mobile, GOV.UK-style error summary. Overlap: all of these, including the sticky bar and error summary pattern. The only non-overlap is the copy.

evidence: All three tests fail on identity-carrying elements; product specificity lives only in content and copy (anchor 1: product content on a frame that fails the swap test).
Placeholder wrench thumbnails on all ten cards occupy the slot where the real tools could be shown.
Masthead identity is a stock wrench glyph and the name in bold body type.
Copy and data are genuinely product-bound (tool specs, deposits, Wed/Sat 'Open' sessions, membership-card and volunteer language) and should be kept.

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: identical wrench icon in a flat pale-green box on all 10 tool cards.
Browser-default controls in the filter panel: native date input 'yyyy/mm/dd' and native select, misaligned.
Identity is only the name in bold body-size text next to a stock wrench glyph.
No focal point beyond the H1 on find, basket, confirm and done; sections are a heading plus a list or a form.
Bands stop short: empty grey band below the footer on basket and done at 1280.
Half-empty layouts at wide widths: confirm and done content sits in the left ~55%; basket has one full-width session card above five cramped ones.
Headings differ from body only in size and weight.
Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on the find page at 375, making the two drills indistinguishable.
evidence: items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png first viewport: H1, grey paragraph, search field, uniform cards with repeated wrench glyphs.
done default 1280-light: key-value box, text box, outline button; no confirmation moment.
Clean and careful in copy, so not unappealing; reads as a default listing/form, so plain.

attributes.x_evidence: deposit on every card; specs (chuck, batteries, weight, case) on the tool page; 'Nothing is paid online. Bring the deposit and your membership card'; one filled button per page; sessions shown as real times.
attributes.y_evidence: nothing reads corporate: no hero, no marketing claims, no stock photography. Neutral, institution-like frame (could be a council form) leans slightly toward anonymous rather than corporate.

attributes.x_evidence: copy only: 'run by volunteers', 'A volunteer will check the tool with you', 'we will hold the tool for the next one', the desk phone number in the footer.
attributes.y_evidence: no folksy devices (good), but also no visual lever expresses neighbourly: no community centre, no people, no local mark, no warmth in type or colour; the grey-green ground and system-like sans read municipal.

attributes.x_evidence: clear labels and hints ('On your membership card, like FT-01234'), linked error summary, Open tags on session days, consistent 4px radius and borders.
attributes.y_evidence: care breaks in execution: sticky bar covers calendar and listbox, misaligned Details columns, truncated names at 375, two badge treatments in dark mode, basket count stays (1) after confirmation, sessions listed latest first.

brand_fit.weakest_pair: neighbourly, not folksy: carried by copy alone; no visual lever expresses it.
brand_fit.mode_fit: All surfaces are Operate/Read and the design is correctly quiet and conventional in structure (standard nav, form controls, error summary). The issue is not too much expression but that the identity floor (name as a mark, the membership-card green as a recognisable motif, real tool imagery) is missing.

specificity.anchor: 1: product content on a frame that fails the swap test
specificity.evidence: All three tests fail; tool names, deposits, Open sessions and volunteer copy are the only product-bound elements; placeholder wrench thumbnails and glyph-plus-name masthead are portable.

hierarchy.label: (judged)
hierarchy.anchor: 3: clear at main widths with one named lapse

coherence.label: (judged)
coherence.evidence: One family, one radius, borders-only depth, one green across all routes and both themes. Lapses: available badge loses its tinted pill in dark mode while 'later' badges keep a grey pill; two Details lists with different label widths; filter panel uses native controls unlike the custom loan select.

restraint.label: (judged)
restraint.anchor: cap 2: no focal point or signature

brand_fit.label: (judged)
brand_fit.evidence: practical reflected; neighbourly carried only by copy; careful undermined by execution lapses (see brand_fit).

execution.label: (judged)
execution.anchor: 2: clean at main widths, rough at edges
execution.evidence: 1280 light pages are tidy. Rough: sticky bar overlapping calendar rows and the loan listbox (tool 1280 day-chosen, 375 dark loan-open); toast over calendar header; truncated card titles at 375; 'FT-/01234' broken in error text; misaligned filter controls; dark badge inconsistency; empty band below footer on short pages.

appeal.label: (judged)
appeal.evidence: Identity only the name; placeholder thumbnails and native filter controls on show; no typographic moment, imagery or colour with an expressive role on any screen.

agreements: Sticky action bar overlapping content: FUN-06 'Overlapping text: #reserve', A11Y-05 focused day buttons and 'One week' hidden behind div.actionbar, CMP-06 'Saturday 17 October' close to 'Reserve this tool'. I noted the bar covering calendar rows and the open listbox.
Truncated tool names on find cards at narrow widths: FUN-06 'Clipped text in ... h2.card__title' on 9-10 cards, A11Y-08/09 clipping.

Available badge contrast: A11Y-11 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' below 4.5:1 (18 hits) and axe color-contrast; matches my note that the dark-theme available badge lost its pill and renders mid-green text on dark.
Search placed after the list at narrow widths: A11Y-03 'Focus order jumps back: Electric wet tile saw -> Search tools'.
detector_only: FUN-05 / A11Y-07 horizontal overflow and no reflow at 320 px on find; not checked at 320 by me before unsealing. Recorded as post-unseal finding? No: it is a measured G3 failure, left to the auditor.

TYP-15 one-word last lines in hints and headings ('Check and confirm', 'Nothing is paid online...'), LAY-05 body text near viewport edge, LAY-04 cramped card padding - measured craft, G3 territory; LAY-05 likely a consequence of the 320 overflow.
A11Y-03 'Not reachable by keyboard' for nav, calendar days and Reserve - behavioural, not visible in stills.
COL-14 weak APCA on grey secondary text (footer, hints) - consistent with the many grey hint lines I saw; not double-counted.
critic_only: Placeholder wrench thumbnails on every card (no SLP rule fired).
Masthead identity is a stock glyph plus the name in body type; no designed mark.
Native date input and select in the filter panel, misaligned with each other.
Basket sessions ordered latest first with an odd one-full-width-plus-five layout at 1280.
Done page keeps 'Basket (1)' after confirmation and does not emphasise reservation number or session.
Empty grey band below the footer on basket and done at 1280.
Dark-theme available badge rendered without its tinted pill while unavailable badges keep theirs (inverse emphasis).
Two Details lists with mismatched label columns on the tool page.
false_positives: TYP-15 on short key-value values such as 'Saturday 10 October' and 'hard case, 18 bits included' in a narrow dd column: these are two-to-four-word data values, a single orphan word there costs little; low-value hit rather than a defect.
No detector flagged anti-slop tells (SLP); that is not a false positive but shows the design is tell-free while still generic, which detectors cannot judge.
detector_comparison.post_unseal_notes: Nothing in the detector output would change my specificity or appeal verdict.

findings.title: Every tool card shows the same placeholder wrench thumbnail
findings.description: All ten cards on the find page carry an identical wrench line glyph in a flat pale-green square, at every width and in both themes. The thumbnail slot is the only imagery slot on the product and it shows nothing about the tool.
findings.impact: Members may struggle to recognise 'the drill with two batteries' at a glance and the page is likely to read as unfinished; the repeated glyph adds visual weight without information.
findings.recommendation: Decide what the thumbnail is for: real photographs of the library's own tools (supplied by the owner, labelled slots until then), a per-category drawn mark, or remove the slot so the name and availability lead.

findings.title: No identity beyond the name: stock glyph plus bold body text in the masthead, no product-derived device
findings.description: The masthead is a wrench line icon and 'Fernhill Tool Library' set in the body family at body size, bold. No surface carries a mark, the membership-card green as a recognisable motif, the community centre, or any device from the library's world; the declared membership-card origin of the green is invisible.
findings.impact: With only copy differentiating it, the service is likely to read as a generic council or booking form; 'neighbourly' has no visual carrier, which may weaken members' sense that this is their local library.
findings.recommendation: Decide on an identity floor that comes from the library itself (the name as a designed mark, the membership card as a recurring referent, one signature taken from the session mechanism) and carry it quietly on every Operate surface without adding hero moments.

findings.title: Sticky reserve bar covers calendar rows and the open loan-length list
findings.description: On the tool page the white action bar overlays the second calendar row at 1280 (day-chosen, added) and hides all loan-length options except the first when the list is open at 375 dark. The toast 'Added to your basket' also sits over the weekday header.
findings.impact: Members choosing a pick-up day or loan length may not see the options they need, on the one page where they make both decisions.

evidence.detail: Corroborated after unsealing by FUN-06 #reserve, A11Y-05 focused elements hidden behind div.actionbar, CMP-06.

findings.recommendation: Decide how the bar and the content share the viewport (reserved space at the page end, scroll padding, listbox layering) so no choice sits under it.

findings.title: Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on phone widths
findings.description: At 375 the card titles cut off ('Cordless drill 18 V, co...', 'Extension ladder 3 m ...'), so the two cordless drills, which differ only by 'two batteries' / 'one battery', look identical.
findings.impact: On the primary device the distinguishing words a member is looking for may be hidden, so they could open the wrong tool.
findings.recommendation: Let titles wrap at narrow widths; decide whether the thumbnail earns its width on phones.

findings.title: Filter panel uses unstyled native date and select controls, misaligned
findings.description: The 'Available from' date field shows the browser 'yyyy/mm/dd' mask and system calendar glyph, and 'Category' is a native select with a system chevron whose label sits ~30px lower than 'Available from'. The rest of the product uses a custom-styled loan select.
findings.impact: The panel is likely to read as unfinished, and the 'yyyy/mm/dd' mask contradicts the en-GB 'Saturday 17 October' date format used everywhere else.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether filtering by day should reuse the session calendar or the same styled control family as the loan select, and align the fields on one baseline.

findings.title: Dark theme drops the available badge's pill, inverting emphasis
findings.description: In dark mode 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' renders as mid-green text with no visible tinted background, while 'Available from Sat 17/24 Oct' and 'Wed 21 Oct' keep a grey pill. The more useful state now looks weaker than the less useful one.
findings.impact: Members in dark mode, which the brief says is common, may read the soonest-available tools as the de-emphasised ones.

evidence.detail: A11Y-11 contrast hits on 'Available from ...' corroborate after unsealing.

findings.recommendation: Compose the dark badge so 'available now' keeps the stronger treatment of the two states.

findings.title: Done page gives no emphasis to what the member must remember, and the basket count stays at 1
findings.description: Reservation number FT-4471, the session and the deposit are body-weight values in a key-value box identical to the confirm summary; the masthead still reads 'Basket (1)' after confirming. Below the footer an empty grey band fills the 1280 viewport.
findings.impact: The one Read surface may not make the reservation feel done; members may doubt whether the tool is still in the basket and may not retain the session time.

locations.selector: main summary box; header basket link

findings.recommendation: Decide which one fact leads the done page (the session to turn up at) and give it the page's single typographic moment; clear the basket state.

findings.title: Basket session list runs latest-first in an uneven one-plus-five layout at desktop widths
findings.description: At 1280 'Wednesday 28 October' sits alone in a full-width card, followed by five narrow cards (24, 21, 17, 14, 10 October) where each date wraps to three lines. Order runs backwards in time.
findings.impact: Members choosing when to collect may read the far-off session as the recommended one and scan backwards to find the soonest; the layout looks unfinished.
findings.recommendation: Decide on chronological order and one consistent card width for sessions.

findings.title: Tool details split into two lists with misaligned value columns
findings.description: Category/Deposit/Available from values start at x≈224 while Chuck/Batteries/Weight/Case values start at x≈180, with a small extra gap between the groups, on every width.
findings.impact: The spec table, which members use to confirm they have the right tool, may scan as two unrelated blocks; it undercuts 'careful'.
findings.recommendation: Use one label column for all details.

findings.title: Search drops below the whole tool list on phones
findings.description: At 375 the 'Search tools' field and filter button appear after all ten cards, while at 1280 they sit above the grid.
findings.impact: Members on phones, the main device, may not find search until they have scrolled the whole list; the order also differs from the desktop layout.

evidence.detail: A11Y-03 focus order jumps back to Search tools corroborates.

findings.recommendation: Keep the search above the list at every width.

strengths: Copy is concrete and in the members' words: tool names with specs, deposit on every card, 'Nothing is paid online. Bring the deposit and your membership card', 'A volunteer will check the tool with you'.
Session days marked 'Open' on the calendar (green dot on phones) tie the picker to the library's real opening mechanism.
Conventional, correct Operate structure: one filled button per page, linked error summary with inline messages, restrained colour, consistent radius and borders.
keep: Keep the volunteer-desk voice and the session-aware calendar; any identity work must sit on top of them, not replace them.
notes: Ran as an isolated subagent. No builder material or other critics' files read. Bash was denied for one listing command; screenshots were read directly. Checked find, tool, basket, confirm, done at 1280/375 light and selected dark and state captures, not every file of the 540-capture matrix. No baseline in packet, so pairwise not run (DES-05 not_applicable).
